Shipping & logistics

Partner: hasenkamp Berlin

Crating, transport & installation

All shipping, climate-controlled transport, and on-site installation is handled by our long-time partner hasenkamp Internationale Transporte Berlin. Coordination through the gallery's registrar.

Conservation & condition

For conservation issues, restoration questions, and detailed condition reports — please contact the registrar with the work title, year, and high-resolution images of the area of concern.

registrar@betongalerie.de

Mailing list

Monthly · Bilingual DE / EN

A monthly newsletter with exhibition openings, fair announcements, new publications, and occasional studio dispatches from the artists. You can unsubscribe at any time; we do not share addresses with third parties.

Online

Find Beton Galerie online

The gallery posts installation views, opening notices, and the occasional studio visit on Instagram. Long-form research and the artists' reference libraries live on Are.na. Performance and video documentation is on Vimeo.

Beton Galerie

Auguststraße 47, 10117 Berlin-Mitte. Founded 2011 by Anneliese Vogel and Karim Behzadi. Representing twelve international artists working in sculpture, installation, video, painting, and performance.
